paragraphs: The role of Junior Data Scientist & Marketing Effectiveness at Ekimetrics in London offers the chance to work as a Junior Consultant, Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness. Ekimetrics is a leader in Marketing Effectiveness, Data Science and AI‑powered solutions and engages across four business offerings – MMM (mixed market modelling), customer analytics, data science transformations and AI4 sustainability – from its London office. You will work on Marketing Mix Modelling and Customer Analytics projects end‑to‑end, gathering and analysing data, building statistical machine‑learning models and delivering presentations for clients across retail, consumer goods, luxury fashion, insurance and many other industries.

I have built predictive models using scikit‑learn, TensorFlow and Keras, deploying them through FastAPI within Docker containers to ensure reproducible environments. In another project I managed extensive metadata pipelines, integrating fourteen source datasets to enrich feature engineering and improve model robustness. Both experiences required me to design end‑to‑end modelling workflows, from data preprocessing to model validation, aligning with the econometrics and advanced analytics expectations of the role. My hands‑on use of these tools demonstrates the capability to deliver high‑quality modelling solutions for Marketing Effectiveness challenges and to support data‑driven decision making for senior stakeholders today.

I have communicated complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, using an agentic approach combined with Python and PostgreSQL to build transparent data pipelines that stakeholders could query directly. Continuous integration practices ensured that each code change was tested and documented, fostering trust and clear communication throughout the project lifecycle. Additionally, I implemented SSL encryption and AWS Cognito authentication for a FinTech application, guaranteeing secure data access while explaining security protocols to non‑technical clients. These experiences illustrate my ability to convey analytical insights and technical details effectively, meeting the communication standards required for this consultancy role.
